messages.subject: Dashboard for the team
parts:
I have built a shiny dashboard which it is needed to be displayed to a monitor 24/7 without having the app shutting down after the pre-set idle time passes. The is no budget to switch to a paid plan to shinyapps.io. My team uses AWS buckets, however.
My question is: Can I create a container using docker and https://hub.docker.com/r/quantumobject/docker-shiny/ in order to avoid the application shutting down after a certain amount of time? Is there any other alternative?
